items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: when I had, when I had Harry Porphy's job... there's two brothers... I had Magma Net on a piano... John Veen on a drum.

ctx.x: But you'd have two guitars and a bass, isn't it?

Ah, you see, uh, one guitar I had, when I had, when I had Harry Porphy's job, Charlie, there's two brothers. One of them had red, red hair, one of them had blonde hair. And there was, there was two brothers that had, uh, a ranch on, on, on, on Liberty, on, yeah, Liberty Street. And, um, I had Magma Net on a piano, John Veen, old man, we called it Tar-kun for nickname. John Veen on a drum.
